propositions: Pause/resume surface must preserve old blob readers and retain legacy reconcile vocabulary while implementing new durable pause/resume behavior

New pause blocks before lock acquisition or ticket mutation and returns exit code 0 with anchored BRIDGE_PAUSED JSON marker; scheduled workflow skips commit-and-push only when this exact marker is present

Resume must be CAS-safe on observed ref OID and recover from corrupt blobs without decoding; pause provenance (git user.email and first-pause RFC3339 time) must be enforced with conflict detection on different-reason, blank-reason, missing-identity, and missing-remote cases
Same-reason pause is idempotent and preserves metadata; different reason, blank reason, missing identity, missing remote, and CAS conflicts refuse without overwrite

Remote refs/reconciler/gate blob remains dual-format with both gated_mode: reconcile-check and paused/reason/who/paused_at fields; pre-gate reconcile-check early return and old rebar reconcile --mode vocabulary remain functional
